items.rationale: Assuming escape-of-water cover is in force, the failed internal heating pipe is assessed under 2.4.3(a). Like-for-like fittings under 7.1.7(c) are estimated at 4 × €10.50.

Under 7.1.7(c) and 7.1.8(e), the five elbows are payable only if the 28 mm fittings were needed for the documented reconnection; the invoice lists 15 mm replacement pipe. The conditional gross estimate is €104 for all five.
Under 7.1.8(e), this elbow is excluded unless the 28 mm size can be tied to the actual repair. If verified, one elbow is estimated at €21 gross.
Minor repair fasteners are covered under 7.1.7(c) without individual tracing under 7.1.8(e). Eight screws at €1.20 total €9.60.
Repair fixings are eligible under 7.1.7(c), subject to their use on the repaired assembly. Four clamps at €4.70 total €18.80.
Section 7.1.7(c) covers necessary support fixings, although 7.1.8(e) excludes sizes unrelated to the documented repair. Four clamps are estimated at €25 gross.
Sections 2.4.3(a) and 7.1.7(c) cover the like-for-like internal heating-pipe repair. The calibrated gross estimate for the invoiced 6.4 m is €200.
Section 7.1.7(g) covers necessary labour on both visits; the one-charge limit in 7.1.7(f) applies to travel, not labour. The gross estimate for 6.75 hours is €628.
Necessary helper labour is payable at customary rates under 7.1.7(g). The gross estimate for 5.75 hours is €388.
Section 7.1.7(c) covers reinstatement of the pre-loss insulation on the repaired pipe. The gross estimate for six pieces is €154.
Under 7.1.7(c), the mats are payable if used to reinstate existing insulation rather than duplicating the pipe insulation charge. The gross estimate for six mats is €55.
Binding wire used to refit the insulation is a covered fastening under 7.1.7(c). Two kilograms at about €13.90 total approximately €28.
Sections 7.1.7(c) and 7.1.8(e) allow a reasonable lump sum for minor installation materials. The calibrated gross allowance is €45.
Section 7.1.7(f) allows the first travel charge on the plumbing invoice. One charge is estimated at €82 gross.
Section 7.1.7(f) excludes a second travel charge on the same contractor's invoice even when the return visit was necessary. The conditional benchmark for one trip is €82.
Sections 5.2.1 and 7.1.7(a) cover necessary disposal of removed pipe and insulation; the photo shows this waste separately from tile debris. One disposal charge is estimated at €60 gross.
Section 7.1.8(b) excludes provisioning for the contractor's own personnel. The conditional benchmark for the flat charge is €40.
Section 7.1.8(b) excludes processing fees added to itemised labour and materials. The conditional benchmark for the fee is €25.
Sections 7.1.5 and 7.1.7(a) cover lifting tiles in the documented damaged patch. Eight square metres at €30 per square metre total €240 gross, excluding separately charged disposal.

items.description: Supply and lay replacement floor tiles
items.rationale: Sections 7.1.5 and 7.1.9 limit reinstatement to the damaged 8 m² at the pre-loss tile grade. The conditional allowance is 8 × €42.50 for standard tiles, with adhesive, grout and installation labour assessed separately to avoid duplication under 7.1.8(c).
Section 7.1.7(c) covers standard adhesive and grout for the affected patch if not charged elsewhere. The materials allowance is about 8 × €8, or €64 gross.

Section 7.1.7(g) covers customary labour for laying the damaged patch, but 7.1.8(c) bars a second payment if the supply-and-lay line already includes those hours. If separately chargeable, six hours are estimated at €479 gross.

items.description: Clean, disinfect and recoat undamaged tiles
items.rationale: Sections 7.1.5 and 7.1.8(a) exclude treatment of surrounding tiles that were never wet. The conditional benchmark for five hours is €300.
Sections 5.2.1 and 7.1.7(a) cover disposal of the removed tiles. The separate ceramic waste shown in the photo supports a distinct €60 charge rather than a duplicate under 7.1.8(c).
Section 7.1.7(f) allows the tiler's first travel charge on its separate invoice; the plumber's charge does not count against it. One charge is estimated at €82 gross.
